value.rationale: This is a complete natural initial profile for a classical slowly synchronizing family, not an isolated parameter increment. It exposes a parity-sensitive compression mechanism that the published quadratic reset threshold does not show: one-letter opportunities for effective collision force three-letter recovery before the next such opportunity. Exact prescribed-rank information can be used when comparing slow families before full synchronization and when testing rank-compression heuristics.
